rates.quote: 2. Tačiau tokie dividendai taip pat gali būti apmokestinami toje sutartį sudarančioje šalyje, kurios rezidentė yra dividendus mokanti bendrovė, ir pagal tos šalies įstatymus, bet jeigu gavėjas yra tikrasis dividendų savininkas, toks mokestis negali viršyti: a) 5 procentų bendros dividendų sumos, jeigu tikrasis savininkas yra bendrovė (bet ne bendrija), kuriai tiesiogiai priklauso ne mažiau kaip 25 procentai dividendus mokančios bendrovės kapitalo,
b) 15 procentų bendros dividendų sumos visais kitais atvejais.

2. Tačiau tokios palūkanos taip pat gali būti apmokestinamos toje sutartį sudarančioje šalyje, kurioje jos susidaro, ir pagal tos šalies įstatymus, bet jeigu gavėjas yra tikrasis palūkanų savininkas, toks mokestis negali viršyti 10 procentų bendros palūkanų sumos. Sutartį sudarančių šalių kompetentingi asmenys abipusiu susitarimu gali nustatyti šio apribojimo taikymo būdą.

notes: 5% dividend tier: company (not partnership) beneficial owner holding directly >=25% of capital. Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) for the States/subdivisions/local authorities/statutory bodies, central banks, SWEDECORP and similar bodies, loans guaranteed by them, and credit-sale interest between unrelated enterprises - not modelled. ROYALTIES: treaty Art. 12 caps are 5% (industrial, commercial or scientific equipment) and 10% (other) from 1994-01-01. Art. 12(7) is an automatic MFN clause: if Lithuania, in a later treaty with a State that was an OECD member when this treaty was signed, exempts royalties from Lithuanian tax (or narrows the definition / lowers the rates), that treatment applies automatically to this treaty. Trigger: Lithuania-Japan Convention (signed 2017-07-13, in force 2018-08-31, applicable from 2019-01-01; https://e-seimas.lrs.lt/portal/legalAct/lt/TAD/fa4a6dc1ad5411e8aa33fe8f0fea665f) Art. 12(1) taxes royalties only in the residence State and its definition excludes equipment rentals. Modelled as exclusive residence taxation from 2019-01-01, mirroring the Finnish MoF notice SopS 67/2019 which applies the identical Lithuania-Finland MFN from 1 January 2019. Art. 31(2): in force 30 days after the last notification (EIF 1993-12-30 per e-seimas status); WHT provisions apply from 1 January of the following calendar year -> 1994-01-01. PPT: both States list the treaty under the MLI, but Sweden reserved Art. 35(7)(a) and has not notified completion of its internal procedures for this treaty, so the MLI (incl. Art. 7 PPT) is not yet effective for LT-SE. No 365-day holding period: Lithuania reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely (Art. 8(3)(a)). [curated: dropped ROYALTY tier — MFN 0% (Lithuania–Japan) not confirmed by an official notice]
